messages:
nina_sales: Passing Arborlytics to CS — signed today for Dedicated (4x A100) with EU data residency and VPC peering. Exec sponsor: Marco Duarte (CTO). Go-live target 2024-07-08. Known risks: SAML cert rotation window, corporate firewall requiring specific ports, and prompt drift on legacy dataset. Uploading prompt pack now. tagging @omar_cs and @kevin_eng to pick up. :handshake:

omar_cs: I can own CSM. I'll schedule kickoff and own enablement. Need legal/billing contacts, exact SLA ask, and whether they want audit logs pushed to their EU S3. Also want the success criteria (latency targets, extraction accuracy) from Sales.

lina_csm: Day-to-day CSM here. Planning kickoff week of 6/24. Request eng/SE join a 25m slot to walk through SAML test flow and prompt engineering best practices. We also want to run nightly evals during pilot. Who will provide labeled GT?

nina_sales: Legal = contracts@arborlytics.ai, Billing = finance@arborlytics.ai. SLA ask: 99.5% pilot, aiming for 99.9% long term. They asked for audit log export to EU S3 and monthly cost projection. Prompt pack link: https://redwood.share/arborlytics/promptpack (uploaded). Customer offered 20 labeled examples; product to add 30 more to reach 50.

ops_bot: Created tickets CS-8401 "Arborlytics EU peering - network contact needed" and ENG-7042 "Arborlytics SAML cert rotation - triage" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8401 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7042

kevin_eng: I'll triage ENG-7042. Need SAML metadata XML, SP entityID, and cert expiry. For peering: need allowed CIDR ranges and preferred routing (private vs NAT). ETA for initial triage 48h. Can join kickoff for infra portion. Recommend enabling prefix caching for recurring system prompts and auto-fallback to redwood-v1-7b when pool exhausted.

matt_se: I'll own runbook + cost calc. Draft checklist: 1) Confirm VPC CIDRs & firewall rules 2) SAML metadata + test user 3) Model pin + quant profile 4) KV cache sizing and prefix cache 5) Eval harness + 50 labeled examples 6) Audit log export to EU S3. Sample provisioning snippet:

```
# Arborlytics provisioning vars
CUSTOMER=arborlytics
POOL_MIN=4
MODEL=redwood-v2-13b-quant
PIN=true
VPC_PEER=true
REGION=eu-west-1
```

lina_csm: Enablement asks: 1) Eng/SE to join 25m kickoff for SSO+prompt tips; 2) Provide a simple test plan for SAML validation; 3) Share nightly eval template. Also capture top-10 prompt failure cases during week 1. @kevin_eng @matt_se

kevin_eng: We'll provide a 15-step SAML test plan and a sandbox test account. Also recommend setting up nightly regression that alerts if extraction accuracy falls below 94%. We'll attach triage notes to ENG-7042 after investigation.

omar_cs: Action items (initial): 1) Nina to confirm legal/billing contacts and upload final prompt pack (DONE) 2) Ops_bot tickets CS-8401 / ENG-7042 live 3) Kevin to triage SAML/peering (ETA 48h) 4) Matt to draft runbook + cost sheet by EOD tomorrow 5) Lina to schedule kickoff week of 6/24 and collect labeled examples (customer 20 + product 30). I'll track weekly and mark renewal risk if pilot metrics miss targets. Anyone want to add owners or edit? :eyes:
